summary: United Microelectronics Corporation filed a Form 6-K announcing the disposal of 2,896,036 common shares of Novatek Microelectronics Corporation at an average price of NT$479.8 per share, for total proceeds of NT$1,389,518,072. The shares were transferred to settle conversions of zero coupon exchangeable bonds due 2026. The transaction, executed over June 17–18, 2026, generated an impact on retained earnings of NT$1,007,168,830 (no net income effect). Following the disposal, UMC holds 12,373,857 Novatek shares, a 2.03% stake. No board resolution or advisor was named. This represents a debt-to-equity conversion under the bond terms; watch for potential further dilution or bond redemption updates.
